methods.label: Shortest path and equality
methods.explanation: By the fact that the line segment between two points is the shortest path, \(AC+BC\geq AB=7\text{ cm}\). Equality holds when C lies on segment AB, so the minimum value is 7.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 shortest-path and segment-addition facts to establish and attain the bound.
